title: Guidelines for design and construction of mould and core drying ovens for foundries
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard gives guidelines for design and construction of mould and core drying ovens for use in foundries, with any of the following fuels: a) fuel oil, b) liquefied petroleum gases ( LPG ), * Rules for rounding off numerical values ( revised ). 3 IS : 10298 - 1982 c) LPG — air mixture, d) natural gas, and e) coke oven or producer gas.
clause_3_terminology: Guidelines for design and construction of mould and core drying ovens for foundries

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
